name: @saibotsivad/hato
description: Courier pigeon that receives GitHub webhooks on a Cloudflare Worker and streams them to an on-prem machine over a WebSocket, with buffering while you're offline.

WEBHOOK_SECRET.description: The secret GitHub uses to sign webhook deliveries. Generate one with `openssl rand -hex 32`, then paste the **same value** into the *Secret* field when you create the webhook in GitHub.

CLIENT_TOKEN.description: The token your local client uses to connect. Generate one with `openssl rand -hex 32` and put it in `client/.env` as `CLIENT_TOKEN`.

RETENTION_DAYS.description: How many days to keep events your client hasn't acknowledged before deleting them.
